title: Jarring Malaysian Tempeh Bowl
description: A spicy, herbal tempeh bowl that packs protein and flavor in a single pot, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add a splash of oil.
Add the diced tempeh and cook until golden brown, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic, bell pepper, carrot, and broccoli, and cook for another 4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and soy sauce, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the sriracha sauce, lime juice, and red chili flakes, stirring to combine.
Reduce heat to low and let the sauce thicken for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more lime juice or sriracha if desired.
Remove from heat and fold in fresh cilantro.
Serve the tempeh mixture over steamed jasmine rice or cauliflower rice for a low-carb option.
Garnish with a wedge of lime and extra cilantro, and enjoy a flavorful solo dinner.
